_comment: Canonical request/response contract for the Semrush-market generation Lambda (#3165). api-service PR #3252 mirrors this exact shape. 'request' is the RequestResponse payload the handler consumes; 'service_response' is what generate_validated_prompts returns (category populated internally); 'response' is what the DEPLOYED handler emits on the wire — category deferred to '' for v1 (_V1_INCLUDE_CATEGORY=False). language_evidence[i] is index-aligned with prompts[i]. Contract-semantics notes: market_country is the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 CODE ('FR'); DRS resolves it to a display name internally for the prompt (a name is also accepted). audience is OPTIONAL and omitted at onboarding (DRS proceeds without audience guidance). model is api-service-owned; DRS honors it and must be one of {gpt-5.4, gpt-5.4-mini, gpt-5.4-nano, gpt-5-nano} or it returns a terminal gate_error. catalogue_status is 'populated' | 'empty' only (a capped/truncated catalogue is still 'populated').
